title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：wire　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wire 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the builder ① laid the wire that no assistant in the site would have noted, and he said the laying was the whole of the month. The ② wire, meaning the cable itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a wire, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ wire in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ wire at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wire, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the builder said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wire was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the cable. The ⑥ wire, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; wire, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a cable and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ wire had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ wire of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of noting; wire, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wire I remember is the cable noted in the plan, which closed in 1960 and is still noted as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ wire, my mother said in 1962, is the only cable that improves by being noted; every wire, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like a cable. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电线；金属丝（指工地里每一根旁边的那一根）
B. n. 电线；金属丝（指那根电线本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay the wire 架这一根电线
D. n. 电线；金属丝（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 电线之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的电线之事）
F. n. 电线；金属丝（指施工图里写到、被记下的那一根）
G. n. 电线、连通（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 连通（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: laid the wire that no assistant in the site would have noted
The wire, meaning the cable itself and not the beam
the wire at the far wall
the wire was the whole of the matter
the wire had become a line in a plan
The wire of the whole thing
A wire, my mother said in 1962

answers.why: lay the wire 意为“架这一根电线”，1953 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯记下的一根电线做了一遍。
wire 意为“电线；金属丝”，指那根电线本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
wire 意为“电线；金属丝”，指工地里每一根旁边的那一根，每一根旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
wire 意为“电线；金属丝”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wire 意为“电线、连通”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这根连通就是那件事的全部。
wire 意为“连通”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那根电线，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wire 意为“电线；金属丝”，指施工图里写到、被记下的那一根，到 1958 年这一根成了施工图里的一行。
wire 意为“电线之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的电线之事是一处工地和三个月份的记下。
wire 意为“电线；金属丝”，我记得的是施工图里记下过的那一根，1960 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一根。
wire 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，电线是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的电线。
